full_prompt_en: The image is a square theatrical photograph of two elaborately costumed performers extending their arms across a dark stage. The background is a deep blue-black performance space with indistinct warm lights and blurred supporting figures, so the main pair remain clearly separated from the ensemble. Along the upper left, a few small amber highlights suggest stage fixtures or decorative lights without forming readable lettering. In the centre-left, a woman stands with her body angled towards her partner, one arm reaching outward and slightly upward towards the left edge. Her other arm is lifted above the space between the pair, creating an open, celebratory silhouette. Her face is covered in pale turquoise and cream theatrical makeup, with darker accents around the eyes and a broad animated expression. Above her head, a tall arrangement of teal, ochre and orange feathers or leaf-shaped costume pieces fans upward in uneven points. Her fitted bodice has warm metallic-looking ornament, and layered orange, amber and dark gold fabric flares from the waist. The skirt-like panels overlap in jagged, petal-shaped strips, revealing part of one leg and a pale gold stage shoe. On the centre-right, a man leans slightly towards her, kneeling on one knee while the opposite foot is planted and its knee remains raised. One arm stretches towards the upper right, the open hand separated clearly against the dark background. His short reddish hair and pale blue-white facial makeup echo the woman's bright face without matching her headdress. A light cream and gold jacket falls open over a darker patterned vest or shirt, with textured trim and a slightly oversized, loose fit. Below it, pale baggy trousers gather around the raised knee and narrow towards wrapped, gold-toned boots. The fabric surfaces show small creases, worn-looking texture and flashes of reflected light. Behind their lower bodies, additional performers appear as soft vertical shapes in bronze and cream costumes, kept distant and out of focus. Across the bottom, the dark glossy stage floor carries faint reflections of the shoes and bright garments, grounding the movement. The lighting is warm and directional from above and the front-left, catching faces, hands and metallic cloth while cool blue darkness recedes behind them. The overall composition is energetic and open, balancing two outward-reaching figures, intricate warm costumes and deep theatrical shadows in a moment of shared performance.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形舞台摄影，两位服饰繁复的演员在暗色舞台上向外伸展双臂。背景是深蓝黑表演空间，只有朦胧暖灯和模糊配角，使主要二人与后方群体分离。左上沿几个琥珀色小亮点像舞台灯具或装饰灯，没有构成可读文字。中间偏左，一位女子身体斜向搭档，一臂向左边缘外伸并略微抬高，另一只手臂抬至两人之间的上方，形成开阔欢快姿态。她面部涂有浅青绿与乳白舞台妆，眼周加深，表情生动。头顶高耸的青绿、赭黄和橙色羽毛或叶片状服装饰物以不规则尖端向上展开。合身上衣带暖金属感装饰，橙色、琥珀色和暗金色层叠布料从腰部散开。裙状布片像参差花瓣重叠，露出部分腿部和浅金舞鞋。中间偏右，一位男子稍向她倾身，单膝触地，另一只脚踩实地面，膝部抬高。一臂伸向右上方，张开的手在深背景前清楚分离。他的短红棕发与浅蓝白面妆呼应女子明亮面孔，但没有同样的头饰。浅乳白金色外套敞开，露出较暗的花纹背心或内衫，饰边有纹理，版型宽松。浅色宽裤在抬起膝部聚拢，向下收至缠裹式金色靴子。衣料上可见小褶皱、略显旧化的表面和反光。二人下半身后方，其他演员像穿青铜与乳白服装的柔软竖影，位于远处焦外。底部深色光亮舞台地面淡淡映出鞋子和亮服装，使动作落在实处。光线温暖，从上方和左前方照来，照亮面孔、手和金属感布料，冷蓝暗处向后退去。整体构图生动开阔，以两位向外伸展的人物、复杂暖色戏服和深舞台阴影平衡一个共同表演的瞬间。
style_prompt_en: The photographic style is theatrical, with highly textured warm ornament emerging from deep, cool shadow. Teal and pale cream accents sharpen amber, bronze and burnt-orange passages. Layered pointed shapes, curved gesture lines and generous diagonals create an expanding rhythm, while soft background forms preserve a distinct focal plane. Directional overhead-front light picks out bright edges, expressive contours and scattered metallic reflections. Dark glossy areas repeat a few colours in subdued reflections. The overall composition feels animated and celebratory, combining elaborate tactile surfaces, selective sharpness and broad negative space without flattening the scene into evenly lit decoration.
style_prompt_zh: 摄影风格具有舞台感，纹理丰富的暖色装饰从深冷阴影中浮现。青绿和浅乳白强调琥珀、青铜与焦橙区域。层叠尖形、弯曲姿态线与舒展斜线形成扩张节奏，柔化背景保证主要焦平面清楚。上前方定向光挑亮边缘、富于表现的轮廓和零散金属反射。深色光滑区域以低调倒影重复少量色彩。整体生动欢悦，将精致可触表面、选择性清晰与大块暗空间结合，避免成为平均照亮的平面装饰。
theme_en: Two costumed performers opening their arms on stage
theme_zh: 舞台上张开双臂的两位盛装演员
name: Cirque du Soleil
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
